game: Nemesis 2 (Konami 1987, MSX1 MegaROM RC-751, Konami SCC mapper, 16 x 8 KB banks)

sources.notation: pNN:ADDR = bank NN at its mapped Z80 address (bank 0 fixed at 0x4000-0x5FFF, bank 1 at 0x6000, bank 2 at 0x8000, bank 3/10/11 at 0xA000); RAM 0xE000-0xEFFF
sources.verification: everything below is read from the listing and its comments or from docs/*.md; nothing was verified by playing (see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md)

key_ram.0xE22A: stage after the interior / secret stage
key_ram.0xE22C: return to the stage computed by p01:7C59
key_ram.0xE3D0: secret run: 1 scroll stopped, 2 one column per frame

campaign.state_machine: p00:5615 (11 game states): 0 intro, 1 title, 2 demo, 3 game start (pilot scene), 4 new life, 5 play, 6 death, 7 GAME OVER / CONTINUE F5, 8 return after interior or ending (calls siguiente_fase p01:7C1C), 9 pause, 10 ending
campaign.start: stage 1 with 3 lives (p00:5AD8); stage of a new life = highest reached 0xE206, or the one computed by p01:7C59 when 0xE22C is set, or 0xE22A from stage 8 on (empieza_la_fase p01:60FD)
campaign.next_stage_rule: fase_que_sigue_a p01:7C59: outbound (0xE20A even) A+1 up to 7, then 6 and 0xE20A += 1 (odd = inbound); inbound A-1 down to 0, then 1 and 0xE20A += 1 (even again: a second loop)
campaign.siguiente_fase: p01:7C1C: with 0xE22B (ship entered the boss) -> 0xE1DB = 1, 0xE22A = next stage, go to map 8; from map 8 -> 0xE1DB = 2, 0xE206 + 1, level + 0x80, go to 0xE22A; from maps 9-11 -> same without 0xE1DB; otherwise 0xE206 + 1, level + 0x80, go to fase_que_sigue
campaign.halfway_ending: after the stage 7 boss (final_del_juego p01:7BEA, 0xE1D6 = 0): game state 10 runs p10:B993 steps 1 -> 2 -> 8 -> 9 (outside Japan) and returns to play through state 8
campaign.inbound: 6 -> 5 -> 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0 with 0xE20A odd (code says: more enemies / shots in many places, e.g. stage 5 event 900 frames, boss 1 fires earlier p11:AA3B, type 0x0B shoots p03:A662, generador_5 p01:71EA, class 1 boxes p03:B4B9, map objects with bit 7 only inbound p02:87C1)
campaign.secret_routes: 3 -> 9 -> (4 outbound | 2 inbound); 6 -> 10 -> (7 outbound | 5 inbound); 10 -> 11 -> 0xE22A (a_la_subfase p01:7AC2, guion_fase_10 p01:7BFD)
campaign.real_ending: after the stage 0 core (guion_fase_0, 0xE1D6 = 1): p10:BBAC final_de_verdad; then p00:5955 shows THE END / EXTEND F5 text (p03:B2AF); F5 + space -> LET'S START -> state 8 -> stage 1 again (second loop); without F5 for 600 frames -> SEE YOU NEXT!!!! -> lives 0 -> other player or title
campaign.cheats_q_bert: only with Q*bert in another slot (0xF0F5 bit 0): pause typing p03:BD7C; LARS18TH full power (p03:BDD8), NEMESIS skips to the next stage (p03:BE87), METALION invulnerable (p03:BE90)
unresolved: The return trip and the second loop are read from the code only (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md)
Japanese-MSX ending paths (BIOS 0x002B) take extra text steps; texts not decoded here

stage_track_table.reader: musica_de_la_zona p01:7C90: each frame, when no boss/event/secret-run/interior-ending is active, walks the stage list [column lo, hi][sound]: the first entry whose column is above the scroll column gives the track to play (unless already playing, 0xE0A0, or 0xFF); exactly at an entry column it sends 0xF1; a new track is followed by command 0xF0
notes: 0x2B is the common opening track of stages 1-7 (first 0x60-0x85 columns); 0x34 plays in the final stretch of stages 1-7 (from 0x1A0-0x2DA on, i.e. the boss zone); stage 0 switches to 0x35 at 0x1B0; interior (8) plays 0x35 then silence 0x43 from column 0x90; secret stages 9-11 play 0x36 then 0x2A

track names: THE-MUSIC.md only names 0x3E (game start), 0x3F (story), 0x40 (halfway ending), 0x41 (real ending), 0x3B (boss explodes), 0x28 (warning), 0x3A (boss beaten, p02:9218), 0x3D (ship lost), 0x42 (game over); the stage tracks are 'table tracks' with durations (0x29 48 s, 0x2B 66 s, 0x2C 64 s, 0x2D 59 s, 0x2E 19 s, 0x30 >75 s, 0x31 57 s, 0x32 64 s, 0x33 43 s, 0x34 26 s, 0x35 13 s, 0x36 51 s, 0x5B 56 s)
0x5B is in THE-MUSIC.md as a table track but not in p01:7CE6: its caller UNRESOLVED

normal.record: p03:A889 (4-byte sprite records by up/down input, dibujo_de_la_nave p03:A78C)

shield.record: p03:A895 (+12 flashing with 0xE1C3 bit 2); second sprite 8 px ahead (p11:A000)
shield.when: shield box used (pon_escudo p01:7F98) or restored BACK UP; 10 hits in 0xE401; gone at 0 (p02:8E38)

drill_R_DRILL.record: p03:A8AD + 4 x 0xE441 (6 frames, one every 3 frames, p03:A846)
drill_R_DRILL.when: picking up special map capsule 4 (p02:90A1): 15-second countdown (0xE439 = 4), label 22; breaks breakable map (p02:8481, nave_contra_el_mapa p02:8413) and only dies on other walls; the shield box then only sets 0xE445 (p01:7F87); reverts to normal (or shield if 0xE401 > 0) when the countdown ends and on state 8 (estado_8_vuelve p00:58DC)
drill_R_DRILL.applies_in: any stage where a class >= 2 special capsule object with value 4 is in the map lists (p12:BA12) - per-stage list UNRESOLVED

penguin.when: Penguin Adventure cartridge in another slot (0xF0F5 bit 2, slot check p03:BCB1 (docs) / que_cartucho_hay p03:BCF0)
penguin.record: p03:A879 (player 1, blue) / p03:A881 (player 2, magenta) by 0xE1C2 bit 7, +4 with 0xE1C3 bit 3 (ficha_de_la_nave p03:A82E -> p03:A862)
penguin.sprites: p12:BF19 / p12:BF82 (p00:4381); characters p11:BF63 (caracteres_del_pinguino p00:43B4); options animate every 4 frames instead of 2 (p03:AA93)
penguin.applies: whole game, both players; replaces normal and shield looks (shield shown as the second sprite colour 2/6/9, R.DRILL colour 10, dibujo_del_pinguino p03:A7F8)

player_variants.two_players: alternating play (0xE1C2 bit 5 two players, bit 7 which one); each keeps a copy of 0xE200-0xE23F at 0xE240 (p00:582E)
